<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Architecture" id="arch-3"> <mxGraphModel dx="3156" dy="3378" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="2400" pageHeight="1800" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="actorBox" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#bac8d3;strokeColor=#23445d;verticalAlign=top;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="200" x="40" y="760" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="actor1" parent="1" style="shape=umlActor;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;html=1;outlineConnect=0;" value="Player" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="30" x="80" y="800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="actor2" parent="1" style="shape=umlActor;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;html=1;outlineConnect=0;" value="Player" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="30" x="160" y="800" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="actor3" parent="1" style="shape=umlActor;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;html=1;outlineConnect=0;" value="Admin" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="30" x="120" y="900" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="gateway" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" value="API Gateway" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="160" x="310" y="810" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="registry" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;" value="Service Registry" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="160" x="310" y="930" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="container" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#000000;verticalAlign=top;fontStyle=1;fontSize=15;spacingTop=4;" value="Microservices" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1680" width="1780" x="516" y="-17" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="player" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>Player Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> the player's identity, friends and online<br>presence, inventory, player progression (XP),<br>trading between players (including ensuring<br>correctness and making trades across lobbies).<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the item recipes or their<br>acquisition — Crafting Service does; Player<br>Service only receives the items from the Crafting<br>Service after they are crafted.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the real-time actions state —<br>Game Service does; Game Service tells which<br>stats to update with the corresponding values." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="420" x="700" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="game" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>Game Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> the active sessions, the day-night cycle,<br>session timers and timed events, the spawning<br>and short-lived behavior of Zombies during a<br>cycle. Live progress is delivered over WebSockets.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> players inventory or progress —<br>Player Service does.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the state of the map — World<br>Service does; Game Service requests changes and<br>reads current state via query.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the state of the base — Base<br>Service does.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> resource quantities — Resource<br>Service does; Game Service only runs the timer.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the exam system — Exam Service<br>does. <b>Does not own</b> the configuration of<br>zombies — Zombie Service does." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="420" x="1200" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="exam" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>Exam Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> exam definitions, the static question<br>bank, exam attempts, scores, pass/fail results,<br>per-course progress, grades, achievements and<br>diploma milestones.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> player identity, XP or levels —<br>Player Service owns them; Exam Service publishes<br>exam_completed and achievement_unlocked, and<br>Player Service applies the reward itself.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the player's inventory — rewards<br>travel as event payloads and are never written<br>directly by Exam Service.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the campus map or wing unlocking<br>— World Service owns it; Exam Service publishes<br>exam_passed and World Service decides which<br>section to generate.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> encounters, the day/night cycle or<br>action timers — Game Service owns them." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="420" x="1700" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="resource" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#b0e3e6;strokeColor=#0e8088;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>Resource Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> resource types and quantities (wood, metal<br>scraps, paper, food), which node/player they<br>belong to, validation and application of resource<br>changes, and consumption for barricading,<br>upgrading, crafting and feeding Kiki.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the physical map or resource node<br>placement — World Service does; Resource Service<br>references nodes by ID.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> gathering action timers or the<br>decision that an action has completed — Game<br>Service does; Resource Service applies the change<br>idempotently, so duplicate events can't award<br>resources twice.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> crafting recipes — Crafting<br>Service does.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> new nodes created by map<br>expansion — consumes section_unlocked." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="420" x="700" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zombie" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>Zombie Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> zombie type definitions, per-type combat<br>and behavior stats (health, speed, attack<br>strength, perception radius), special abilities,<br>the Professor/Tourist zombie categories, and<br>custom zombie variants.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> live/active zombie instances or<br>their in-session behavior — Game Service does;<br>Zombie Service exposes configuration via query.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> spawn locations or spawn timing<br>— Game Service does, in coordination with World<br>Service's spawn points; Zombie Service only<br>supplies which types are eligible.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> exam encounters triggered by<br>Professor Zombies — Exam Service does; Game<br>Service mediates the encounter." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="420" x="1200" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="world" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>World Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> the persistent campus map, room types,<br>resource node placement, zombie spawn points and<br>their configuration, section unlock state and<br>procedural generation rules.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> resource quantities or transactions<br>— Resource Service owns them; World Service<br>publishes section_unlocked and Resource Service<br>creates the economy entries for the new nodes.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> what players have built — Base<br>Service owns it; Base Service references room<br>identifiers, while World Service stores no<br>construction state at all.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> zombie stats or behaviour — Zombie<br>Service owns them; spawn points store only type<br>references.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the academic rules that trigger<br>unlocking — consumes exam_passed, idempotent." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="420" x="1700" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="crafting" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>Crafting Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> recipe definitions (required inputs, output<br>item), recipe unlock conditions, and the atomic<br>crafting operation (validating materials and<br>executing the craft).<br><br><b>Does not own</b> resource quantities — Resource<br>Service owns them; Crafting Service validates and<br>deducts required materials through it before<br>crafting.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the player's inventory — Player<br>Service owns it; crafted objects are transferred<br>there once the craft succeeds.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> exam/level/unlock progress — Exam<br>Service and Player Service own it; Crafting<br>Service checks against it to determine if a<br>recipe is available to a player." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="420" x="700" y="1220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="base" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=12;fontSize=11;" value="<font style="font-size:15px"><b>Base Service</b></font><br><br><b>Owns</b> the player's survival base state, barricade<br>levels, facility upgrades, storage capacity, and<br>base decorations/upgrades. Hosts Kiki.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> the campus geography (rooms,<br>corridors, zones) — World Service owns it; Base<br>Service queries World Service to confirm which<br>rooms are eligible for base expansion.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> resource quantities — Resource<br>Service owns them; Base Service requests<br>validation/deduction when a player spends them on<br>reinforcing, barricading or upgrading.<br><br><b>Does not own</b> player inventory — Player Service<br>owns it; any items or rewards a player receives<br>(e.g. through Kiki) are transferred there." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="380" width="420" x="1200" y="1220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=14;spacingTop=10;fontSize=12;" value="<b>Legend</b><br><br>──── synchronous request / response<br><br>- - - - asynchronous event" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="300" x="1700" y="1300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_actor_gw" edge="1" div.div:
Player Service
Owns the player's identity, friends and online
presence, inventory, player progression (XP),
trading between players (including ensuring
correctness and making trades across lobbies).
Does not own the item recipes or their
acquisition — Crafting Service does; Player
Service only receives the items from the Crafting
Service after they are crafted.
Does not own the real-time actions state —
Game Service does; Game Service tells which
stats to update with the corresponding values.

text.tspan: Player Service
Owns the player's identity, friends and online
presence, inventory, player progression (XP),
trading between players (including ensuring
correctness and making trades across lobbies).
Does not own the item recipes or their
acquisition — Crafting Service does; Player
Service only receives the items from the Crafting
Service after they are crafted.
Does not own the real-time actions state —
Game Service does; Game Service tells which
stats to update with the corresponding values.

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Game Service
Owns the active sessions, the day-night cycle,
session timers and timed events, the spawning
and short-lived behavior of Zombies during a
cycle. Live progress is delivered over WebSockets.
Does not own players inventory or progress —
Player Service does.
Does not own the state of the map — World
Service does; Game Service requests changes and
reads current state via query.
Does not own the state of the base — Base
Service does.
Does not own resource quantities — Resource
Service does; Game Service only runs the timer.
Does not own the exam system — Exam Service
does. Does not own the configuration of
zombies — Zombie Service does.

text.tspan: Game Service
Owns the active sessions, the day-night cycle,
session timers and timed events, the spawning
and short-lived behavior of Zombies during a
cycle. Live progress is delivered over WebSockets.
Does not own players inventory or progress —
Player Service does.
Does not own the state of the map — World
Service does; Game Service requests changes and
reads current state via query.
Does not own the state of the base — Base
Service does.
Does not own resource quantities — Resource
Service does; Game Service only runs the timer.
Does not own the exam system — Exam Service
does. Does not own the configuration of
zombies — Zombie Service does.

div.div:
Exam Service
Owns exam definitions, the static question
bank, exam attempts, scores, pass/fail results,
per-course progress, grades, achievements and
diploma milestones.
Does not own player identity, XP or levels —
Player Service owns them; Exam Service publishes
exam_completed and achievement_unlocked, and
Player Service applies the reward itself.
Does not own the player's inventory — rewards
travel as event payloads and are never written
directly by Exam Service.
Does not own the campus map or wing unlocking
— World Service owns it; Exam Service publishes
exam_passed and World Service decides which
section to generate.
Does not own encounters, the day/night cycle or
action timers — Game Service owns them.

text.tspan: Exam Service

directly by Exam Service.
Does not own the campus map or wing unlocking
— World Service owns it; Exam Service publishes
exam_passed and World Service decides which
section to generate.
Does not own encounters, the day/night cycle or
action timers — Game Service owns them.

div.div:
Resource Service
Owns resource types and quantities (wood, metal
scraps, paper, food), which node/player they
belong to, validation and application of resource
changes, and consumption for barricading,
upgrading, crafting and feeding Kiki.
Does not own the physical map or resource node
placement — World Service does; Resource Service
references nodes by ID.
Does not own gathering action timers or the
decision that an action has completed — Game
Service does; Resource Service applies the change
idempotently, so duplicate events can't award
resources twice.
Does not own crafting recipes — Crafting
Service does.
Does not own new nodes created by map
expansion — consumes section_unlocked.

text.tspan: Resource Service

references nodes by ID.
Does not own gathering action timers or the
decision that an action has completed — Game
Service does; Resource Service applies the change
idempotently, so duplicate events can't award
resources twice.
Does not own crafting recipes — Crafting
Service does.
Does not own new nodes created by map
expansion — consumes section_unlocked.

div.div:
Zombie Service
Owns zombie type definitions, per-type combat
and behavior stats (health, speed, attack
strength, perception radius), special abilities,
the Professor/Tourist zombie categories, and
custom zombie variants.
Does not own live/active zombie instances or
their in-session behavior — Game Service does;
Zombie Service exposes configuration via query.
Does not own spawn locations or spawn timing
— Game Service does, in coordination with World
Service's spawn points; Zombie Service only
supplies which types are eligible.
Does not own exam encounters triggered by
Professor Zombies — Exam Service does; Game
Service mediates the encounter.

text.tspan: Zombie Service

Does not own exam encounters triggered by
Professor Zombies — Exam Service does; Game

div.div:
World Service
Owns the persistent campus map, room types,
resource node placement, zombie spawn points and
their configuration, section unlock state and
procedural generation rules.
Does not own resource quantities or transactions
— Resource Service owns them; World Service
publishes section_unlocked and Resource Service
creates the economy entries for the new nodes.
Does not own what players have built — Base
Service owns it; Base Service references room
identifiers, while World Service stores no
construction state at all.
Does not own zombie stats or behaviour — Zombie
Service owns them; spawn points store only type
references.
Does not own the academic rules that trigger
unlocking — consumes exam_passed, idempotent.

text.tspan: World Service
Owns the persistent campus map, room types,
resource node placement, zombie spawn points and
their configuration, section unlock state and

identifiers, while World Service stores no
construction state at all.
Does not own zombie stats or behaviour — Zombie
Service owns them; spawn points store only type
references.

unlocking — consumes exam_passed, idempotent.

div.div:
Crafting Service
Owns recipe definitions (required inputs, output
item), recipe unlock conditions, and the atomic
crafting operation (validating materials and
executing the craft).
Does not own resource quantities — Resource
Service owns them; Crafting Service validates and
deducts required materials through it before
crafting.
Does not own the player's inventory — Player
Service owns it; crafted objects are transferred
there once the craft succeeds.
Does not own exam/level/unlock progress — Exam
Service and Player Service own it; Crafting
Service checks against it to determine if a
recipe is available to a player.

text.tspan: Crafting Service

div.div:
Base Service
Owns the player's survival base state, barricade
levels, facility upgrades, storage capacity, and
base decorations/upgrades. Hosts Kiki.
Does not own the campus geography (rooms,
corridors, zones) — World Service owns it; Base
Service queries World Service to confirm which
rooms are eligible for base expansion.
Does not own resource quantities — Resource
Service owns them; Base Service requests
validation/deduction when a player spends them on
reinforcing, barricading or upgrading.
Does not own player inventory — Player Service
owns it; any items or rewards a player receives
(e.g. through Kiki) are transferred there.

text.tspan: Base Service

Does not own resource quantities — Resource

reinforcing, barricading or upgrading.
Does not own player inventory — Player Service
owns it; any items or rewards a player receives
(e.g. through Kiki) are transferred there.
